measures.name: Premium
measures.definition: Premium charged for the cover, excluding taxes and fees.

measures.name: Premium tax
measures.definition: Tax levied on premium (e.g. GST, IPT), as charged to the policyholder.

measures.name: Fee
measures.definition: Policy, installment or service fee charged in addition to premium.

measures.name: Invoiced amount
measures.definition: Amount billed on one invoice; becomes an invoice receivable.

measures.name: Payment amount
measures.definition: Cash received in one payment (receipt), before allocation.

measures.name: Allocated amount
measures.definition: Part of a payment applied to one invoice.

measures.name: Refund amount
measures.definition: Cash returned to the payer.

measures.name: Write-off amount
measures.definition: Receivable written off as uncollectable or below threshold, as reported by the source.

measures.name: Commission
measures.definition: Commission payable to the distributor on premium.

measures.name: Claim payment
measures.definition: Amount paid on a claim.

measures.name: Claim reserve movement
measures.definition: Change in the case reserve held for a claim.

measures.name: Earned premium
measures.definition: Premium earned over the period, as computed by the earnings system.

measures.name: Stamp duty
measures.definition: State or territory stamp duty charged on premium, as charged to the policyholder.

measures.name: Statutory levy
measures.definition: Statutory levy collected with premium (e.g. emergency or fire services levy), as charged to the policyholder.

measures.name: Tax on commission
measures.definition: Tax (e.g. GST) on commission payable to the distributor.

measures.name: Dishonoured payment
measures.definition: Amount of a payment returned unpaid by the bank; it reverses the receipt.

measures.name: Unearned premium
measures.definition: Premium not yet earned at the end of the period (the unearned premium reserve), as computed by the earnings system.

measures.name: Claim handling expense
measures.definition: Loss adjustment expense paid on a claim (assessors, legal, investigation), separate from the indemnity.

measures.name: Excess
measures.definition: Excess (deductible) borne by the insured on a claim, collected or deducted from the payment.

measures.name: Claim recovery
measures.definition: Amount recovered on a claim from salvage, subrogation or a third party.

measures.name: Reinsurance premium ceded
measures.definition: Premium ceded to reinsurers under a treaty or facultative arrangement.

measures.name: Reinsurance commission
measures.definition: Commission received from reinsurers on ceded premium.

measures.name: Reinsurance recovery
measures.definition: Claim amount recoverable from reinsurers.
